list.heading: Plans
list.subtitle: What each package contains. An account is created on one plan, and the plan's limits apply to it.
list.emptyDescription: Accounts are created on a plan, so define the first one before creating an account.
list.deleteQuestionFree: The plan is removed and nothing can be created on it any more. No account is on it, so no customer is affected.
list.deleteQuestionInUse: {count} account is on this plan, so the panel will refuse to delete it and change nothing. Move that account to another plan or delete it first. | {count} accounts are on this plan, so the panel will refuse to delete it and change nothing. Move those accounts to another plan or delete them first.

form.subtitleNew: Name the plan and set what each account on it may use. The panel checks these values before sending them, and the server checks them again.
form.subtitleEdit: Change the name or the limits. The panel checks these values before sending them, and the server checks them again.
form.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted since this link was made.
form.limitsHint: Zero FTPS logins or zero cron entries sells none of them. Every other limit must be at least 1.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most {max} characters.
errors.nameControl: Name must not contain control characters.

reach.title: An edit reaches the accounts already on this plan
reach.accounts: {count} account is on this plan. The new limits apply to it at once. | {count} accounts are on this plan. The new limits apply to all of them at once.
reach.disk: A lowered disk quota is written to every account on the server. If any account already uses more than the new figure, the panel refuses the whole edit and changes nothing.
reach.counts: A lowered number of sites, databases, logins or cron entries removes nothing: an account above it keeps what it has and cannot add more.
reach.none: No account is on this plan yet, so this edit changes nothing for anyone.

form.diskLowered: The disk quota goes down from {from} MB to {to} MB. If any account on this plan already uses more than {to} MB, the server refuses the edit and nothing is changed.
